_about: Vault Librarian settings. Copy to config/vault.json (setup/install.ps1 does this and asks the main questions); vault.json is local and never committed. %VARS% are expanded. Keys starting with _ are comments. Feature switches: see docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
_note_sandbox: Claude desktop sessions see AppData\Local through the Claude app sandbox: start jobs via Task Scheduler (Start-ScheduledTask), not by running python directly from Claude.

owner._about: Who owns the vault: named in Claude's instructions and messages (empty name: 'the owner'); id is generated.by of your own notes; about is one optional sentence for Claude (e.g. your profession); note_label is the title of your note on an item (the [!note] callout).

mail._about: Microsoft 365 mail through Graph (an Entra app registration with Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send). false: no Remember-folder intake, no emails; the OneDrive dropbox, connector and home page still work.

schedule._about: Run times of the scheduled tasks (home page plan, 2026-11-12). setup/register_tasks.ps1 and the home page's Settings tab both use these; the Intake hours are intake.first_hour/last_hour and QueueNight starts at queue.night_window[0]. daily_summary_slot is another app's morning run to keep clear of (read only here: Claude work is kept out of it). Change times on the home page, or edit here and re-run register_tasks.ps1.

podcasts._about: Optional: a separate podcast pipeline script that writes Podcast Summary notes. Leave vault_episode empty to skip.

remember._about: YouTube Remember intake (jobs/remember.py, task \VaultLibrarian\YouTubeRemember at 02:05). Plan: 2026-09-26 YouTube Remember intake - plan.md

queue._about: Intake queue (jobs/vqueue.py, jobs/queue_run.py). Plan: 2026-09-28 Intake queue for files and email - plan.md. enabled=false: queue_run.py dry-runs only and intake.py keeps working Remember. Switch over = queue.enabled true + intake.py wrapper (phase 1 step 4).

rules.why: analyses after new items (concept analysis plan, 2026-09-28)

queue._models_about: Model per route. Every Claude call picks its model here (route or the request's model key, else default); nothing inherits the Claude Code default any more. Opus is kept for whole-item analysis and the book-level synthesis (route analyze); per-chapter part analyses, related-only redos, books and other summaries use Sonnet; short classification and description calls use Haiku. Aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku) follow the newest model of each tier.

analysis._about: Concept analysis (jobs/analyze.py, route analyze). Plan: 2026-09-28 Concept analysis and links - plan.md. Notes created after `since` are analyzed once filed; Reference notes only from Resources; older notes only on request (vqueue.py analyze).

concept_merge._about: Regular combining of overlapping concepts (jobs/concept_merge.py, run from Nightly when due). every_days: how often (0 = off; also on the home page). Name rules plus meaning (local embeddings, similarity threshold), then one Claude call confirms which pairs substantially overlap. Pending concepts are combined automatically (auto_merge_pending); pairs involving an approved concept become 'Same concept?' questions in the morning email.

pacing._about: Overnight pacing (jobs/pacing.py, usage_probe.py): books and long summaries run until tonight's share of the week's unused usage is spent, aiming to end each week at weekly_goal_pct, never taking the 5-hour session past session_max_pct (room for your other Claude use). If usage can't be read, the fixed *_fallback limits apply. queue.books_per_night / claude_calls_per_day are used only when enabled is false.

mcp._about: Vault connector (service/vault_mcp.py; plan 2026-10-08 Vault search, section 6). caller_check: off | log | enforce (enforce once the log shows calls come from caller_range).

originals._about: Text of embedded originals into the search index (jobs/originals.py; plan 2026-10-08 Vault search, phase 4). Order: book originals, card-only PDF articles/references/recipes, manuals. Task Originals at 02:45 uses leftover night time until stop_by, after the queue work; on request (originals.py request) Intake starts it in the daytime for up to 3 hours. No Claude usage.
